leadText:
Mick (Japanese: ニック Nick) is a character of the day who appeared in Battling the Bully!. 

Mick was a shy boy who didn't have too much confidence. One day, he encountered that came falling from the sky and into his arms. It electrocuted him out of fright, and he assumed that, because it can use attacks, it was the pre-evolved form of a . He proceeded to show it off to his friends Glenn and Sean. However, Sean identified it as a Pikachu, and Mick left.

He bonded with Pikachu and later met , , and . Ash taught Mick how to battle, letting him use Pikachu while Ash used Krokorok, and later . Mick was thrilled to have learned how to battle, and then returned to battle Glenn and Sean. The three of them had a Double Battle, with Sean and Glenn using a and belonging to Sean's father, and Mick using Pikachu and Krokorok. Mick ended up winning the match due to Sean and Glenn constantly arguing with each other. He and his friends watched as Ash Krokorok.
